# Vendored libraries

## lamejs 1.2.1 (`lame.min.js`)
MP3 encoder (a JavaScript port of LAME), used only when exporting an MP3.
Loaded on demand inside `js/mp3-worker.js`; unmodified from the npm package.

- Source: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs (npm: `lamejs@1.2.1`)
- License: LGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE-lamejs.txt` and https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.html).
  You may replace this file with another build of lamejs.
